description:
Workspace Cargo.toml `[workspace.dependencies]` declares only 7 of the 25 internal crates: jmap-types, jmap-mail-types, jmap-chat-types, jmap-server, jmap-base-client, jmap-chat-server, jmap-mail-client.

Missing: jmap-mime, jmap-mail-server, jmap-contacts-types, jmap-contacts-server, jmap-contacts-client, jmap-calendars-types, jmap-calendars-server, jmap-calendars-client, jmap-tasks-types, jmap-tasks-server, jmap-tasks-client, jmap-filenode-types, jmap-filenode-server, jmap-filenode-client, jmap-sharing-types, jmap-sharing-server, jmap-sharing-client (17 crates).

Each of those is referenced by direct `path = "../X", version = "0.1.X"` in dependents' Cargo.tomls. Coordination of internal version bumps requires editing N files instead of 1.

The recent 'bump all crate versions' commit (0a0dc73) likely had to touch every crate's Cargo.toml because of this.

Fix: add the 17 missing entries to `[workspace.dependencies]` and switch consumers to `{ workspace = true }` references. Tied to JMAP-sc1b.3 (workspace inheritance generally).
title: P3: 17 of 25 internal crates not in workspace.dependencies table
